snippet.title: Into a Hearth Yonder - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Get your first look at Into a Hearth Yonder, a new cozy creature-collecting online co-op action-adventure game set in the fictional world of Viteria. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636510/Into_A_Hearth_Yonder/?beta=1
